name: agent-diff-tracker
description: Automatically shows a diff view of the files your AI coding agent just changed, with a scrollable history sidebar, so you can watch what it's doing in real time.

commands.title: Agent Diff Tracker: Show Latest Changed File Diff

agentDiffTracker.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after a file change before opening its diff. Multiple files that change within this window are treated as one batch.

agentDiffTracker.exclude.description: Glob patterns to ignore when watching for changes.

agentDiffTracker.preserveFocus.description: When true, the diff tab opens without stealing editor focus from where you're typing.

agentDiffTracker.minBurstFilesToAutoOpen.description: Minimum number of files that must change together (within debounceMs) before a diff is auto-opened. Set to 2+ to ignore lone manual edits and only react to agent-style bursts; changes below the threshold still appear in the History view.

agentDiffTracker.maxAutoOpenFiles.description: Maximum number of diff tabs to auto-open at once for a single batch of changes. Remaining files are still recorded in the History view.

agentDiffTracker.maxHistoryEntries.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the Change History sidebar.
